description: He wears an opaque dark-blue knee-length tunic with restrained gold woven geometric borders at neck, front, cuffs and hem over a cream underlayer. A brown textured shoulder cloak is fastened by a round silver-toned decorated brooch and has narrow woven borders. A brown leather-looking belt bears round metal fittings, a decorated buckle and a long hanging end. Loose brown trousers tuck into tall brown cross-strapped boots. The textiles appear dense and wool-like, the pale underlayer linen-like; exact fibers are unconfirmed. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
